headline: VIP Industries Limited: Outcome of Board Meeting

detail: Outcome of Board Meeting - VIP Industries Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board its meeting held today, i.e., Friday, September 18, 2026, has, inter alia, approved the proposal for raising funds for an aggregate amount not exceeding ₹ 500 crores (Rupees Five Hundred Crores) during FY 2026-27, in one or more tranches. The funds may be raised through the issuance of equity shares having a face value of ₹ 2 each and/or debt securities, convertible securities, depository receipts (ADR/GDR), FCCBs, warrants, preference shares or other eligible securities or any other financial instrument (hereinafter referred to as  Securities ).
